[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended artists similar to Bon Iver:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. S. Carey: Former member of Bon Iver's live band, shares a similar atmospheric quality.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Volcano Choir: Another project featuring Justin Vernon (Bon Iver), focuses on vocal harmonies.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. James Blake: Soulful, electronic-infused indie-folk sound similar to Bon Iver's experimental tracks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Ben Howard: British singer-songwriter with intricate fingerpicking and emotive vocals.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. The Antlers: Atmospheric soundscapes and introspective lyrics, often compared to Bon Iver.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended artists similar to Fleet Foxes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Beirut: Eclectic, world-music-inspired indie-folk sound.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Grizzly Bear: Harmony-driven indie-rock sound, often compared to Fleet Foxes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. The Tallest Man on Earth: Swedish singer-songwriter with intricate fingerpicking and poetic lyrics.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. The Lumineers: Acoustic-driven sound with heartfelt lyrics, fits fans of Fleet Foxes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. The Head and the Heart: Similar harmony-rich sound and eclectic instrumentation to Fleet Foxes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Other notable mentions:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Mumford & Sons: Energetic folk-rock spirit.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. The Avett Brothers: Blend of introspective lyrics and catchy instrumentation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. First Aid Kit: Lush harmonies and introspective indie-folk sound.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. The Staves: Intricate harmonies and blend of folk, rock, and pop influences.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Lord Huron: Dreamy, atmospheric quality and introspective lyrics.
